subject: Procurement triggers, approval lanes & invoice cadence — next steps
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>

Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Subject: Procurement triggers, approval lanes & invoice cadence — next steps

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can unblock procurement: 

1) Economic buyer & approvals — You confirmed the CIO (Tom) signs off on technology spend >$250k, with finance approval required for invoices over $50k. Please confirm if legal needs to countersign SOWs or if procurement can sign on legal's behalf for standard terms.

2) Security/compliance — You asked for SOC2 Type II evidence and a standard data handling addendum. I've attached our vendor packet (contains SOC2 report excerpt + DPA) and a draft SOW for the pilot scope.

3) PO / invoicing cadence — Proposal: pilot invoice in two parts (50% start, 50% completion), with Crestline PO referencing HS-45231. Confirm whether Crestline uses a single PO per engagement or one PO per invoice.

4) Decision triggers — Pilot success metric: 98th percentile latency < 250ms on your sample workload and a quality check on 3 canonical prompts. If pilot passes, we fast-track the production contract.

Proposed next actions:
- Sara: confirm PO routing owner and whether procurement@crestlinehealth.com needs a separate SOW attachment on the PO.
- Tom: confirm if CIO signoff is required for the pilot value in this case or only for full production.
- Lauren / Karthik (cc): prepare a one-page procurement playbook we can hand to Crestline that summarizes approval lanes, required artifacts, and invoice references. We'll also include a ready-to-send DocuSign link for the SOW once we confirm signers.

Attachments: Redwood-Vendor-Packet.pdf (SOC2 excerpt, DPA), Draft-SOW-Crestline.docx

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0128

From: Sara Nelson <sara.nelson@crestlinehealth.com>

Cc: Tom Bowers <tom.bowers@crestlinehealth.com>, procurement@crestlinehealth.com
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 13:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement triggers, approval lanes & invoice cadence — next steps

Alex —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from procurement: 

• PO handling — We generally issue one PO per contract; invoices can reference line items on the same PO. For pilots under $25k we sometimes route through a delegated buyer without a full PO. The pilot you described looks likely to require a formal PO.

• Signatures — Legal typically reviews, but procurement can countersign for standard SOWs under $100k. Since this is a pilot ~ $35k, procurement can sign once legal confirms no high-risk clauses.

• Attachments — Procurement wants SOC2 in PDF with the report date visible and a separate one-page DPA summary. The vendor packet looks good from my quick glance but I need the SOC2 as a standalone PDF for our intake form.

Can your team send the SOC2 PDF and a single-page SOW summary we can attach to the PO request? Also please list the invoice remit details we should include on the PO.

I'll loop our AP owner once we have a PO number so we can match invoices.

Thanks,
Sara
Senior Procurement Manager
Crestline Health
sara.nelson@crestlinehealth.com

--

Subject: Procurement playbook & approval lane (draft)

Hi all —

Attaching a short procurement playbook below (paste) and will drop a formal one-pager into the shared Drive link. This is meant to be copy-pasteable into your PO intake form: 

Procurement playbook (draft):
- Engagement: Redwood Inference pilot (Deal HS-45231).
- Artifact list required for intake: 1) One-page SOW summary, 2) Standard SOW (DocuSign-ready), 3) SOC2 Type II PDF, 4) DPA one-pager, 5) Vendor W-9 (on file).
- Approval lanes:
  - < $25k — delegated procurement approval only (no legal countersign).
  - $25k - $100k — Procurement + procurement-side legal review; procurement can sign upon legal clearance.
  - > $100k — Legal + CIO signoff required.
- PO / invoice guidance: Include HubSpot deal ID HS-45231 on the PO; invoice line items should reference pilot start and pilot acceptance deliverable. Default terms Net 30.
- Remit information: invoices@redwood.ai; Redwood Inference Inc., 1200 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103

Next steps: 
1) Sara: confirm this playbook aligns with Crestline intake and whether your procurement team needs any additional fields.
2) Alex: once confirmed, we’ll generate DocuSign SOW and attach vendor packet in Drive.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Alex / Sara / Lauren —

Thanks — playbook looks sensible. A couple final items from my side:

• CIO signoff: For a pilot at $34.5k I can approve directly, no need for an additional CIO-level meeting.
• Timeline: If we get the PO in by Sept 10 we can start integration the week of Sept 20. Procurement will issue a PO referencing deal HS-45231 and attach the one-page SOW.
• Invoicing: AP will expect invoice line items to specify "Pilot Fee — HS-45231" and include the PO number. They prefer separate invoices for start/completion (we can comply).

Please send the SOC2 PDF and the one-page SOW summary to procurement@crestlinehealth.com and we’ll kick off intake.
